title: Protocol for quantification of the lysosomal degradation of extracellular proteins into mammalian cells
protocol: Collect the conditioned medium from Flp-in T-REx HEK293 cells stably expressing clusterin-RFP-GFP-His.
Culture Flp-in T-REx HEK293 cells in 20 100-mm culture dishes with complete DMEM containing 0.1 mg/mL doxycycline at 37°C in 5% CO2 for 2 days.
Exchange the medium to advanced DMEM with 0.1 mg/mL doxycycline when cells reach 70–80% confluence, without adding FBS.
Remove culture medium and wash cells with PBS.
Add advanced DMEM medium with doxycycline to each dish and culture for 4 days.
Transfer conditioned medium into 50 mL conical tubes.
Centrifuge the 50 mL tubes at 780 × g for 20 min at 4°C.
Transfer supernatant to a 200 mL bottle and store at -80°C.
Purify secreted clusterin-RFP-GFP-His protein by Ni-NTA affinity chromatography.
Transfer 1 mL of Ni-NTA agarose resin into a gravity-flow column.
Equilibrate the Ni-NTA agarose resin with 10 mL of column wash buffer 1.
Add 10 mM imidazole to the supernatant (containing POI) to reduce non-specific binding of protein to resin.
Load the supernatant onto the column.
Wash the resin four times with 10 mL of column wash buffer 2.
Elute the clusterin-RFP-GFP-His protein with column elution buffer and collect each elution fraction into a 1.5 mL tube.
Apply 0.5 mL of elution buffer and collect the eluate into a fresh 1.5 mL tube (Fr.1).
Apply 1 mL of elution buffer and collect the eluate into a fresh 1.5 mL tube (Fr.2).
Apply 1 mL of elution buffer and collect the eluate into a fresh 1.5 mL tube (Fr.3).
Apply 0.5 mL of elution buffer and collect the eluate into a fresh 1.5 mL tube (Fr.4).
Apply 0.5 mL of elution buffer and collect the eluate into a fresh 1.5 mL tube (Fr.5).
Detect the fractions containing protein by measuring the absorbance at 280 nm.
Pool fractions 2 and 3, which usually contain eluted protein.
Remove imidazole from the purified protein by ultrafiltration using a Microsep advance centrifugal device (30 kDa MWCO) at 2,380 × g for 30 min at 4°C.
Discard the flow-through and add 2 ml of cold PBS to the centrifugal device.
Repeat steps involving ultrafiltration and addition of PBS at least three times.
Transfer the concentrate to a fresh 1.5 ml tube.
Measure the concentration by determining the OD280.
Store the purified protein at -80°C with 10% glycerol in storage buffer, if desired.
Passage HEK293 cells and seed at approximately 5 × 10^4 cells per well in a 24-well plate with complete DMEM.
Culture cells with or without clusterin-RFP-GFP-His protein and unfolded protein substrate.
Add 0.06 μM Clusterin-RFP-GFP-His protein to advanced DMEM in a 1.5 ml tube.
Mix 2.2 μM luciferase with the Clusterin-RFP-GFP-His solution if required.
Incubate cells under conditions suitable for internalization of proteins and substrate.
Add an equal volume of 2× sample buffer to each fraction after incubation period.
Boil samples at 95°C for 5 min.
Separate fractions by SDS-PAGE and stain with CBB-R250.
Incubate advanced DMEM with or without luciferase and clusterin-RFP-GFP-His protein at 42°C for 20 min.
Wash HEK293 cells with serum-free DMEM.
Exchange the medium for advanced DMEM treated as above.
Culture the cells for 14 h in a humidified atmosphere with 5% CO2.
Dissociate aggregated cells by pipetting if necessary.
Collect the cells on day 3.
Wash the cells with PBS.
Discard the PBS.
Add 100 μL of trypsin solution and incubate at 37°C for 5 min.
Add 200 μL of FACS buffer and suspend the cells by pipetting.
Pass the resuspended cells through a cell strainer.
Transfer the cells to a 5 mL round-bottom tube.
Set up a flow cytometer.
Place the 5 mL tube on the sample collector and run the samples.
Select a cell population and exclude debris by setting the cell size and granularity parameters (forward-scatter area [FSC-A] vs. side-scatter area [SSC-A]).
Exclude duplet cells (side-scatter height [SSC-H] vs. side-scatter width [SSC-W]).
Exclude dead cells (forward-scatter area [FSC-A] vs. DAPI area [DAPI-A]).
Passage HEK293 cells and seed them at 20–40% confluence in a 12-well plate with complete DMEM.
Culture cells with or without clusterin-RFP-GFP-His and unfolded protein substrate.
Incubate advanced DMEM with 0.06 μM clusterin-RFP-GFP-His protein and 2.2 μM luciferase at 42°C for 20 minutes.
Wash HEK293 cells with serum-free DMEM and exchange the medium for advanced DMEM treated as described.
Culture cells in a humidified atmosphere with 5% CO2 for 14 hours.
Lysate the cells for immunoblotting.
Wash the cells with cold PBS.
Discard the PBS and add 500 μl of cold PBS to the cells.
Scrape and transfer the cells to a fresh 1.5 ml tube.
Centrifuge at 2,380 × g for 2 minutes at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant and lyse the cells with 50 μL of lysis buffer.
Incubate the lysate on ice for 15 min.
Centrifuge the lysate at 20,620 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Transfer the supernatant to a fresh 1.5 mL tube.
Measure the protein concentration of the supernatant by Bradford assay (or another standard method).
Mix 40 μL of the supernatant with 10 μL of 6× sample buffer.
Boil the mixture for 5 min at 95°C.
Load 10–20 μg of protein per lane and perform SDS-PAGE.
Perform immunoblotting using standard procedures with a monoclonal anti-RFP antibody (1:1,000 dilution).
Use a monoclonal anti-α tubulin antibody (1:1,000 dilution) for the blot.
Apply an anti-mouse IgG (1:2,000 dilution) as the secondary antibody.
Optional: Examine lysosomal degradation of POI using anti-POI antibody.
